match.common_evidence_basis: Confirmed starting XIs preserve the ranked FOCUS premise. Tokyo Verdy Beleza start Ujihara and Shiokoshi within a normal senior attacking/midfield structure, while AS Elfen start Takahashi with Osone, Higuchi and Tanaka support. No confirmed XI evidence removes the Beleza carrier or Elfen reply route. The lineup check preserves G3 but does not independently promote the mixed fourth-goal routes.
